caption: The drawing depicts two representations of an ornate, oval-shaped gold locket, both rendered in color. The locket is primarily gold with tonal variations to suggest metallic sheen and depth. Each locket features a decorative, symmetrical pattern on its front, incorporating a geometric central element bordered by intricate lines and curves. The central section includes three small, round, white elements that resemble pearls or stones. The locket is topped by a diamond-shaped, hinged bail with an open center, suggesting it is designed to be suspended from a chain. The left side of the page includes a smaller, less detailed version of the same locket within a faint oval outline, while the right side shows the locket in greater detail and a larger scale against a plain, beige background.
title: Locket
